blocks.en: Wormholes are rifts in space that connect two star systems. Like stargates, they allow the travel of ships from one star system to another, but unlike stargates, wormholes are not permanent. They connect two systems for only a short time and collapse when either their lifespan ends or too many ships have passed through them.
blocks.zh: 虫洞（Wormhole）是连接两个星系的空间裂隙。和星门一样，虫洞可以让舰船从一个星系前往另一个星系；但和星门不同的是，虫洞不是永久存在的。它们只会在短时间内连接两个星系，当寿命到期或通过的舰船过多时就会坍塌。

blocks.en: Wormholes can connect any two systems regardless of distance from each other, providing temporary shortcuts to areas that would otherwise take many jumps to reach. Wormholes frequently connect to wormhole space.
blocks.zh: 虫洞可以连接任意两个星系，不论两者相距多远，从而为原本需要跳很多次才能到达的区域提供临时捷径。虫洞经常连接到虫洞空间。

blocks.en: Finding wormholes
blocks.zh: 寻找虫洞

blocks.en: A wormhole leading to W-Space
blocks.zh: 一个通往虫洞空间的虫洞

blocks.en: Wormholes can be found by scanning down cosmic signatures. Once a wormhole is probed down, it can be warped to and jumped through much like a stargate, though unlike gates they must be warped to and then jumped through as a two-step process.
blocks.zh: 虫洞可以通过扫描宇宙信号找到。一旦扫出虫洞，就可以像星门一样跃迁过去并跳跃通过。不过和星门不同，虫洞必须分两步操作：先跃迁过去，再跳跃通过。

blocks.en: IMPORTANT NEW PLAYER TIP: If you've found a wormhole, by all means see what's on the other side if you're curious, but use a cheap ship you can afford to lose, and also a clone you can afford to lose. Make sure the ship you use has core probes and a probe launcher fitted on it. When you pass through the wormhole, immediately right-click and bookmark your entry wormhole before doing anything else. The game does not automatically record your entrance's location, and if you warp away without bookmarking it, you will have to probe your entrance down. If the worst comes to the worst and you find yourself stranded in wormhole space with no probes, you can try contacting EvE-Scout Rescue, who might be able to help.
blocks.zh: 新手重要提示：如果你发现了虫洞，好奇的话尽管过去看看另一边有什么，但要开一艘损失得起的便宜船，并使用一个损失得起的克隆。确保船上装了核心扫描探针和探针发射器。穿过虫洞后，在做任何事之前，立即右键为你进入的虫洞创建书签。游戏不会自动记录入口的位置，如果你没存书签就跃迁走了，就只能用探针重新扫出入口。万一最坏的情况发生，你被困在虫洞空间又没有探针，可以试着联系EvE-Scout Rescue，他们也许能帮上忙。

blocks.en: Destinations
blocks.zh: 目的地

blocks.en: Wormholes lead to many different places: some connect W-Space to mapped New Eden systems (henceforth Known Space or K-Space), others connect from K-Space to W-Space, yet others connect W-Space to other W-Space systems, and some wormholes connect K-Space to K-Space. Wormholes occurring within a W-Space system provide the sole method of inter-system travel for residents of that wormhole: there are no stargates in W-Space.
blocks.zh: 虫洞通往许多不同的地方：有的从虫洞空间连接到已知的新伊甸星系（下文称已知空间，即 K-Space），有的从已知空间连接到虫洞空间，有的从虫洞空间连接到其他虫洞空间星系，还有的从已知空间连接到已知空间。虫洞空间星系内出现的虫洞是该星系居民往来其他星系的唯一途径：虫洞空间里没有星门。

blocks.en: Known Space to Known Space Wormholes are used to quickly travel throughout New Eden, they're also used to access high-sec or low-sec islands without risk of traveling through potentially dangerous space. They're commonly named for their sec status on both ends: High-to-high (H2H), low-to-null (L2N), null-to-high (N2H), etc.
blocks.zh: 已知空间到已知空间的虫洞可用于在新伊甸快速穿行，也可以用来前往高安或低安“孤岛”，而不必冒险穿越可能危险的区域。它们通常按两端的安全等级命名：高安到高安（H2H）、低安到 00（L2N）、00 到高安（N2H）等。

blocks.en: Known Space to Wormhole Space Wormholes connect K-Space to W-Space. Players who do exploration use them to access W-Space to run cosmic anomalies and signatures. W-Space inhabitants use them to shop, resupply, sell loot and products and go on K-Space PvP roams.
blocks.zh: 已知空间到虫洞空间的虫洞连接已知空间和虫洞空间。探索玩家通过它们进入虫洞空间，刷宇宙异常和信号。虫洞居民则通过它们去购物、补给、出售战利品和产品，以及到已知空间进行 PvP 游猎。

blocks.en: Wormhole Space to Wormhole Space Wormholes provide the sole means of interstellar transport between distinct W-Space systems, since there are no gates available. Their dynamic formation and dissolution define W-Space interactions, in the form of PvE—capsuleers killing sleeper rats—or PvP—capsuleers killing each other. W-Space to W-Space wormholes are very important, in part because high-class W-Space systems rarely get direct connections to K-Space.
blocks.zh: 虫洞空间到虫洞空间的虫洞是不同虫洞空间星系之间唯一的星际交通方式，因为那里没有星门。它们的动态生成和消失决定了虫洞空间中的互动，无论是 PvE（克隆飞行员击杀冬眠者怪）还是 PvP（克隆飞行员互相击杀）。虫洞到虫洞的连接非常重要，部分原因是高等级虫洞星系很少直接连到已知空间。

blocks.en: Wormhole identification
blocks.zh: 虫洞识别

blocks.en: Main article: Wormhole attributes
blocks.zh: 主条目：虫洞属性

blocks.en: The color of a wormhole may give you an impression on where it leads. The outline will be the color of your current system and the center will be colored based on where it leads. The color also changes based on the size of the wormhole.
blocks.zh: 虫洞的颜色可以让你大致了解它通向哪里。轮廓是你当前所在星系的颜色，中心则根据目的地着色。颜色还会根据虫洞的尺寸变化。

blocks.en: Right clicking and showing info on wormhole entrances will also display a short bit of text which reveals roughly about where they lead and their stability status. This text is explained below.
blocks.zh: 右键虫洞入口并查看信息，也会显示一小段文字，大致说明它通往哪里以及稳定状态。下文会解释这些文字。

blocks.en: By the name of the WH-system, you can determine its class, statics, possible signatures and anomalies with their NPC composition and damage from them. To do this, you can use the date base of wormholes.
blocks.zh: 根据虫洞星系的名称，你可以查出它的等级、固定虫洞、可能出现的信号和异常，以及其中的 NPC 构成和伤害类型。为此可以使用虫洞数据库。

blocks.en: Wormhole sizes and restrictions
blocks.zh: 虫洞尺寸与限制

blocks.en: Wormholes come with different restrictions. Wormholes not only allow certain amounts of mass through them in their lifetime, but they also have mass restrictions for each particular transfer. For example, some wormholes from K-Space to C3 wormhole space will restrict ships going through to destroyers or smaller.
blocks.zh: 虫洞有各种限制。虫洞不仅在寿命内只允许一定总质量通过，每次通过也有单船质量限制。例如，有些从已知空间通往 C3 虫洞空间的虫洞只允许驱逐舰或更小的舰船通过。

blocks.en: Capital ships with jump drives can go through wormholes, providing the wormhole can support the ship's mass. Cynosural fields can be opened in wormhole space, but ships with jump drives cannot lock on to these fields, nor can they lock on to cynosural fields outside of wormhole space to jump out. Supercapital ships such as Titans and Supercarriers cannot go through wormholes at all, as they are far too large for even the largest wormholes. Capitals can be built in W-space, but they may not be able to take any of exits to K-space or even other W-space connections. Supercapitals cannot be built, as there is no sovereignty in wormhole space.
blocks.zh: 装有跳跃引擎的旗舰可以通过虫洞，前提是虫洞能承受舰船的质量。虫洞空间中可以开启诱导力场，但装有跳跃引擎的舰船无法锁定这些力场，也无法锁定虫洞空间外的诱导力场跳出去。泰坦和超级航母等超级旗舰完全无法通过虫洞，因为它们对最大的虫洞来说也太大了。旗舰可以在虫洞空间中建造，但它们可能无法通过任何通往已知空间甚至其他虫洞空间的出口。超级旗舰则无法建造，因为虫洞空间中没有主权。

blocks.en: The color of the flare around a wormhole can tell you the size of ships that can go through. Color Effects for wormholes are described in more detail in Visual wormhole identification.
blocks.zh: 虫洞周围光晕的颜色可以告诉你能通过的舰船尺寸。虫洞颜色效果的详细说明见虫洞外观识别。

blocks.en: Polarization
blocks.zh: 极化

blocks.en: Jumping through wormholes introduces additional restrictions on how often in a given time a pilot may jump through a particular wormhole. You may not jump through a wormhole in the same direction twice within five minutes. For example, if you jump through a wormhole at 05:00 and then jump back through the wormhole at 05:03, you will be polarized until 05:05, five minutes after your last transit in that direction. When polarized the wormhole will prevent you from jumping through, and present you with a message informing you how much time is left on your polarization timer. Similarly, if you were to jump as soon as the timer was up, you would be polarized on the other side of the hole until 05:08, five minutes after your last transit in that direction.
blocks.zh: 跳跃虫洞还有额外限制，规定了飞行员在一定时间内通过某个虫洞的频率。你不能在五分钟内朝同一方向两次跳过同一个虫洞。例如，你在 05:00 跳过一个虫洞，又在 05:03 跳回来，那么你会被极化到 05:05，即你上一次朝那个方向通过后的五分钟。极化期间虫洞会阻止你跳跃，并提示你极化计时器还剩多少时间。同理，如果你在计时结束时立刻跳过去，你在虫洞另一侧会被极化到 05:08，即你上一次朝那个方向通过后的五分钟。

blocks.en: One way to manage your polarization timer is to check local chat for time stamps (multiple wormhole jump time stamps are kept in the chat, unlike gate jumps in K-space) for your jumps and then plan accordingly.
blocks.zh: 管理极化计时器的一种方法是查看本地频道里你跳跃的时间戳（和已知空间的星门跳跃不同，频道里会保留多次虫洞跳跃的时间戳），然后据此安排。

blocks.en: Keep in mind that this restriction applies to the pilot, not the ship or the account. The same ship can be swapped by ejection and boarding by different capsuleers for immediate transit through the same wormhole. This is very useful for mass reduction operations without need for multiple ships of same type. This is, however, a somewhat more dangerous way to roll a wormhole, as multiple pilots jumping from ship to ship are at least momentarily extremely vulnerable.
blocks.zh: 注意，这个限制针对的是飞行员，而不是舰船或账号。同一艘船可以由不同的克隆飞行员弹出、登船轮换，立刻再次通过同一个虫洞。这在消耗质量行动中非常有用，不需要多艘同型舰船。不过这种“滚洞”方式危险一些，因为在船之间换乘的多名飞行员至少会有片刻处于极其脆弱的状态。

blocks.en: Aggression
blocks.zh: 侵略

blocks.en: Weapon timers do not affect travel through wormholes; you still get them when you aggress capsuleers, but as long as you are not polarized you can jump through a wormhole immediately after aggressing any capsuleer in any manner. This can provide escape options even if you are webbed, scrammed, or bubbled. Aggression timers still prevent tethering and docking at citadels (and NPC stations in Thera), refitting in space, and anything else they normally prohibit.
blocks.zh: 武器计时器不影响通过虫洞；攻击克隆飞行员时你仍会获得武器计时器，但只要没有被极化，你以任何方式攻击任何克隆飞行员后都可以立即跳过虫洞。即使你被网住、被扰断或被困在拦截泡里，这也能提供逃生选项。侵略计时器仍会阻止你在堡垒（以及席拉的 NPC 空间站）系留和停靠、在太空中改装，以及其他它通常禁止的行为。

blocks.en: Although normal aggression does not prevent you from jumping holes, attempting to take a hole to escape from Concord's wrath will result in an error message stating that Concord is using "mysterious technology" to prevent you from jumping.
blocks.zh: 虽然普通的侵略状态不妨碍你跳虫洞，但如果你想借虫洞逃避统合部的制裁，会收到一条错误信息，说统合部正在用“神秘技术”阻止你跳跃。

blocks.en: Wormhole text
blocks.zh: 虫洞描述文字

blocks.en: When on grid with a wormhole entrance, right click on the entrance and click on show info. This will give you information about the wormhole. There are 4 information sections.
blocks.zh: 在与虫洞入口同一网格时，右键入口并点击显示信息，就能看到该虫洞的信息。信息分为 4 个部分。

blocks.zh: 这一部分显示虫洞最早可能关闭的时间，但寿命到期后实际何时关闭存在一定浮动。

blocks.en: It is therefore not recommended to traverse an end of life wormhole without some alternative method of returning back home, such as a corpmate able to scan down a new entrance.
blocks.zh: 因此，除非有其他回家的办法（比如有军团成员能扫出新的入口），否则不建议穿越临近寿命终点的虫洞。

blocks.en: Mass Stability
blocks.zh: 质量稳定性

en: More than 50% remaining
Less than 50% remaining

zh: 剩余超过 50%

blocks.en: Wormhole statics
blocks.zh: 固定虫洞

blocks.en: W-Space systems will always contain one or two wormholes that are referred to as "static". These wormholes, although they disappear with time as other wormholes, are more or less persistent : once the static wormhole collapses, another will re-open somewhere in the system, leading to a different system of same class.
blocks.zh: 虫洞空间星系中总会有一到两个被称为“固定虫洞（static）”的虫洞。这些虫洞虽然也会像其他虫洞一样随时间消失，但大体上是持续存在的：固定虫洞坍塌后，星系中的某处会重新开启一个，通往另一个同等级的星系。

blocks.en: In wormholes of classes 2 and 4, there are usually two statics, and in 1 and 3, one each.
blocks.zh: 2 级和 4 级虫洞通常有两个固定虫洞，1 级和 3 级则各有一个。

blocks.en: For example, a Class 4 W-Space system can have a static Class 3 wormhole. As soon as the wormhole collapses, another wormhole opens to another Class 3 system. It can be very profitable to collapse a static wormhole on purpose, because it then means another neighboring system - and maybe another K-Space exit, as well as new combat and exploration sites to run, not to mention new neighbors to kill!!
blocks.zh: 例如，一个 4 级虫洞星系可能有一个通往 3 级的固定虫洞。这个虫洞一坍塌，就会开启另一个通往别的 3 级星系的虫洞。故意关闭固定虫洞可能非常有利可图，因为这意味着会有另一个相邻星系——也许还有另一个已知空间出口，以及新的战斗和探索站点可刷，更别提还有新邻居可以宰了！！

blocks.en: It can also be used to get rid of a connection to enemy corps or alliances inhabiting that precise system: by collapsing the wormhole you then prevent them from getting into your system, while still having another possible exit from the system.
blocks.zh: 这也可以用来摆脱与驻扎在那个星系的敌对军团或联盟之间的连接：关闭虫洞就能阻止他们进入你的星系，同时你的星系仍有另一个可用的出口。

blocks.en: Wormhole environment
blocks.zh: 虫洞环境

blocks.en: When jumping into a wormhole space, a notice may advise you that there may be changes to the natural physics within this space. For example, you may find that all ships in this W-space have improved shields, or conversely, slower recharge times on shields. There are many possibilities, but remember that they apply to both you and anyone else in the W-space, although not necessarily the Sleepers.
blocks.zh: 跳进虫洞空间时，可能会有提示告诉你这片空间的自然物理规律可能有所变化。例如，你可能发现这个虫洞空间里所有舰船的护盾都得到增强，或者反过来护盾回充变慢。可能性有很多，但要记住，这些效果对你和虫洞空间里的其他任何人都同样适用，不过冬眠者未必受影响。

blocks.en: If there is an effect in play in a system, you will see the message, "Local spatial phenomena may cause strange effects on your ship systems." Look at the target system’s space background and compare with the examples below to determine which phenomena is being displayed.
blocks.zh: 如果星系中存在某种效果，你会看到这条消息：“本地的空间现象可能会对你的舰船系统造成奇怪的影响。”观察目标星系的太空背景，并与下面的示例对比，就能判断是哪种现象。

blocks.en: To determine the strength of the effect, you'll need to know what class the system is. This may be determined from the wormhole you came through. These effects do show up in your ship and module descriptions, so you can also use that to determine what type and strength the effect is.
blocks.zh: 要确定效果的强度，你需要知道星系的等级，这可以从你通过的虫洞判断出来。这些效果也会体现在你的舰船和装备说明中，所以也可以借此判断效果的类型和强度。

blocks.en: For more information, see W-Space system effects.
blocks.zh: 更多信息请见虫洞空间星系效果。

blocks.en: Example wormholes
blocks.zh: 虫洞示例

blocks.en: From the information popup on this wormhole we can tell quite a few things.
blocks.zh: 从这个虫洞的信息弹窗中，我们可以看出不少东西。

en: The B274 name means that this is an entrance, not an exit (which would be a K162). The difference doesn't mean much, at least mechanically, except that an entrance gives much more information. For example, the Wormhole Information article tells us that a B274 wormhole leads to high sec K-space, has a total mass allowance of 2,000,000,000 kg ± 10%, has a per-transit ship mass limit of 375,000,000 kg, and a maximum stable time of 24 hours.
The wormhole is beginning to decay, meaning it is more than 4 hours away from collapsing. Jumping through this hole is quite safe, timewise.
The wormhole has had its stability reduced by a significant amount of mass pushed through it. This is generally known as first shrink. The wormhole is still safe to transit in smaller ships.
Any ship that is Battleship size or smaller can pass through the hole (color of the flare is turquoise).
The cyan wedge around the wormhole entrance tells us that the wormhole has been bookmarked.
zh: B274 这个名称说明这是一个入口，而不是出口（出口会是 K162）。这一区别至少在机制上没多大意义，只是入口能提供多得多的信息。例如，从虫洞信息条目可知，B274 虫洞通往高安已知空间，总质量容量为 2,000,000,000 kg ± 10%，单次通过的舰船质量上限为 375,000,000 kg，最长稳定时间为 24 小时。
虫洞开始衰退，意味着离坍塌还有 4 小时以上。从时间上看，跳过这个虫洞相当安全。
虫洞因大量质量通过而稳定性明显下降，通常称为半质量（first shrink）。小型舰船通过仍然安全。
战列舰及更小尺寸的舰船都能通过（光晕颜色为青绿色）。
虫洞入口周围的青色楔形标记表示这个虫洞已被存为书签。

blocks.en: Again, we can tell quite a few things.
blocks.zh: 同样，我们可以看出不少东西。

en: The K162 name means this is an exit. The name is generic, and we really cannot get any information about the hole - except, the color of the hole means we are going into a C2 system, and the color of the flare says large ships can pass through the wormhole.
The wormhole is beginning to decay, meaning it is more than 4 hours away from collapsing. Jumping through this hole is quite safe, timewise.
The wormhole has had its stability reduced by a significant amount of mass pushed through it. This is generally known as first shrink. The wormhole is still safe to transit in smaller ships.
Any ship that is Battleship size or smaller can pass through the hole (color of the flare is turquoise).
The cyan wedge around the wormhole entrance tells us that the wormhole has been bookmarked.
zh: K162 这个名称说明这是一个出口。这个名称是通用的，我们基本得不到关于这个洞的任何信息——不过虫洞的颜色说明我们将进入一个 C2 星系，光晕的颜色则说明大型舰船可以通过。
虫洞开始衰退，意味着离坍塌还有 4 小时以上。从时间上看，跳过这个虫洞相当安全。
虫洞因大量质量通过而稳定性明显下降，通常称为半质量（first shrink）。小型舰船通过仍然安全。
战列舰及更小尺寸的舰船都能通过（光晕颜色为青绿色）。
虫洞入口周围的青色楔形标记表示这个虫洞已被存为书签。

blocks.en: Again, we can tell quite a few things.
blocks.zh: 同样，我们可以看出不少东西。

en: The O477 name means that this is an entrance. A O477 wormhole leads to C3 W-Space (this can be visually identified by the color of the wormhole), has a total mass allowance of 2,000,000,000 kg ± 10%, has a per-transit ship mass limit of 375,000,000 kg, and a maximum stable time of 16 hours.
The wormhole is beginning to decay, meaning it is more than 4 hours away from collapsing. Jumping through this hole is quite safe, timewise.

The wormhole has had its stability critically disrupted by the mass of numerous ships passing through and is on the verge of collapse. This is generally known as crit. The wormhole is unsafe to transit, as it could collapse behind you and trap you in hostile space. Specially fitted HICs are used to collapse the hole.
Any ship that is Battleship size or smaller can pass through the hole (color of the flare is turquoise).
The cyan wedge around the wormhole entrance tells us that the wormhole has been bookmarked.
zh: O477 这个名称说明这是一个入口。O477 虫洞通往 C3 虫洞空间（也可以从虫洞颜色看出来），总质量容量为 2,000,000,000 kg ± 10%，单次通过的舰船质量上限为 375,000,000 kg，最长稳定时间为 16 小时。
虫洞开始衰退，意味着离坍塌还有 4 小时以上。从时间上看，跳过这个虫洞相当安全。
虫洞因大量舰船通过，稳定性已遭到严重破坏，濒临坍塌，通常称为临界（crit）。此时通过并不安全，因为它可能在你身后坍塌，把你困在敌对空间里。人们会用经过特殊装配的重型拦截巡洋舰来关闭这种虫洞。
战列舰及更小尺寸的舰船都能通过（光晕颜色为青绿色）。
虫洞入口周围的青色楔形标记表示这个虫洞已被存为书签。

blocks.en: The death of a wormhole
blocks.zh: 虫洞的消亡

blocks.en: After a certain amount of mass is transported through or after some time the wormhole will disappear, or collapse. While most wormholes only last for 24 hours, there are some variations to this rule. When a static wormhole collapses a new one with the same properties will spawn somewhere else in the same system. It will have to be scanned down. When a non-static wormhole collapses it simply disappears forever. You can read more on static wormholes in the Wormhole space article. If you get a note saying, "As you pass through the wormhole you realize that it collapses behind you. Have you become trapped?" and do not have a HS static bookmarked or core probe scanner/core probes, call Signal Cartel 911.
blocks.zh: 在一定质量通过或一段时间之后，虫洞会消失，即坍塌。虽然大多数虫洞只持续 24 小时，但也有一些例外。固定虫洞坍塌后，同一星系的其他地方会刷出一个属性相同的新虫洞，需要重新扫描。非固定虫洞坍塌后就永远消失了。关于固定虫洞的更多内容，请阅读虫洞空间条目。如果你收到提示“当你穿过虫洞时，你发现它在你身后坍塌了。你被困住了吗？”，而你既没有存高安固定虫洞的书签，也没有核心探针扫描器/核心探针，请呼叫Signal Cartel 911。

blocks.en: You can artificially induce "premature" death of a wormhole (Unwanted Wormholes). This process is known as rolling.
blocks.zh: 你可以人为促使虫洞“提前”消亡（不需要的虫洞），这个过程称为滚洞（rolling）。

blocks.en: History
blocks.zh: 历史

blocks.en: Wormholes were introduced in the Apocrypha expansion.
blocks.zh: 虫洞是在次元（Apocrypha）资料片中引入的。

blocks.en: Thera and the shattered wormholes were added in the Rhea expansion.
blocks.zh: 席拉和破碎虫洞是在瑞亚（Rhea）资料片中加入的。

blocks.en: The wormhole text was simplified in Version 23.01
blocks.zh: 虫洞描述文字在23.01 版本中得到了简化

blocks.en: Notes
blocks.zh: 备注

en: The fourth wormhole state, "dissipating into the ether", exists in EVE Online's shared cache only. See this article's Discussion page.
zh: 第四种虫洞状态“消散于以太之中（dissipating into the ether）”只存在于 EVE Online 的共享缓存中。参见本条目的讨论页。
